narrative.incident_description: Vulnerability exposure: DEMO-VULN-002 matches software on asset BNK-CBS-01 (hostname cbs-gateway-01, sector banking) and is confirmed affected. No exploitation has been observed in the available evidence.
recommended_next_actions: Confirm the scope by verifying the affected asset BNK-CBS-01 and determining whether the exposure is real.
Preserve relevant ICT system logs for at least 180 days as required by CERT-In Directions.
Apply the vendor patch or implement mitigation measures, or otherwise restrict exposure until the patch can be applied.
Search for any signs of exploitation; if exploitation is detected, reassess reportability and note that the 6-hour reporting clock would start at detection.
